title: AraBERT / AraGPT2 / AraELECTRA
description_en: Pre-trained transformer models for Arabic language understanding and generation. Includes AraBERT v0.1/v1/v2 (BERT-based), AraGPT2 (base/medium/large/mega, trained from scratch on Arabic), and AraELECTRA. Models trained on 77GB of Arabic text with 8.6B words. Available in PyTorch, TF2 and TF1 formats on HuggingFace under aubmindlab.
description: Pre-trained Arabic transformers: AraBERT, AraGPT2, AraELECTRA.
keywords: natural language processing, arabic nlp, deep learning, arabic, bert, gpt2, electra, transformer, arabic-nlp

title_en: ARBML - Arabic NLP and CV Projects
title: ARBML
description_en: Open-source platform implementing many Arabic NLP and computer vision projects with interactive web demos using TensorFlow.js. Covers Arabic diacritization, English-Arabic translation, poem generation, word embeddings, sentiment classification, image captioning, speech recognition, and more. Provides interactive browser-based demos and Google Colab notebooks.
description: Open-source Arabic NLP and CV projects with interactive web demos.
keywords: natural language processing, arabic nlp, computer vision, arabic-nlp, demo, colab, arabic

title: Shakkala
description_en: Deep learning project using recurrent neural network for Arabic text vocalization (tashkeel - automatically adding diacritics to Arabic characters). Trained on over one million sentences with majority historical Arabic data. Achieves up to 95% accuracy. Useful for enhancing text-to-speech systems and improving search results. Available via pip.
description: RNN-based Arabic text diacritization (tashkeel) with 95% accuracy.
description_ar: مشروع شكّالة لتشكيل النصوص العربية تلقائيًا باستخدام الشبكات العصبية التكرارية.
keywords: natural language processing, arabic nlp, text-to-speech, arabic-nlp, deep-learning, lstm, rnn, tashkeel

title: arabic-stop-words
description_en: The largest list of Arabic stop words on GitHub, containing 750 stop words compiled from multiple sources. Useful for Arabic NLP preprocessing tasks such as text classification, information retrieval, and search indexing. Licensed under MIT.
description: Largest Arabic stop words list on GitHub with 750 words from multiple sources.
description_ar: أكبر قائمة لمستبعدات الفهرسة العربية على جيت هاب، تحتوي على 750 كلمة.
keywords: natural language processing, arabic nlp, information retrieval, arabic-nlp, stopwords, arabic-language

title_en: Ar-PHP - PHP Arabic Language Processing Library
title: Ar-PHP
description_en: Open-source PHP library for Arabic language processing enabling professional search, manipulation, and presentation of Arabic text. Features include Arabic spell checker, sentiment analysis, dialect identification, transliteration, number spelling, text standardization, auto summarization, text similarity, prayer times, and Hijri date conversion. Used in Bagisto, Akeneo, LimeSurvey and other projects. Install via Composer.
description: PHP library for Arabic NLP: spell check, sentiment, transliteration, prayer times, Hijri dates.
keywords: natural language processing, arabic nlp, web development, arabic-nlp, php, arabic-sentiment, arabic-numbers

title_en: Tajmeeaton - Arabic Open Source Projects Collection
title: tajmeeaton
description_en: A curated collection of Arabic open-source projects for NLP, Islamic applications, Arabic programming languages, and Arabic UX tools. Covers NLP tools (diacritization, stemming, morphological analysis), Quran and Hadith tools, Arabic programming languages (Alusus, Kalimat), and Arabic fonts. Maintained by the Mobadarah community.
description: Curated collection of Arabic open-source NLP, Islamic, and programming projects.
description_ar: تجميعة من المشاريع مفتوحة المصدر للنهوض بالمحتوى العربي في معالجة اللغة الطبيعية والإسلاميات.
keywords: natural language processing, arabic nlp, arabic language, arabic-nlp, arabic-language, awesome-list, islam

title_en: Hadith Data Sets - Nine Books Collection
title: Hadith-Data-Sets
description_en: Dataset of 62,169 hadiths from the Nine Books (Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan al-Tirmidhi, Sunan al-Nasai, Sunan Abu Dawud, Sunan Ibn Maja, Musnad Ahmad, Maliks Muwatta, Sunan al-Darami) with and without tashkeel. Includes preprocessed version with normalization, stop word removal, and lemmatization. Useful for Arabic NLP research on Islamic texts.
description: 62,169 hadiths from Nine Books with/without tashkeel, preprocessed for NLP.
description_ar: مجموعة بيانات 62,169 حديثاً من الكتب التسعة بالتشكيل وبدونه.
keywords: natural language processing, arabic nlp, islamic texts, arabic-nlp, arabic, hadith, islam, arabic-language

title: Masader
description_en: The largest public catalogue for Arabic NLP and speech datasets, containing over 600 datasets annotated with more than 25 metadata attributes including license, language, dialect, domain, tasks, volume, access, and venue. Developed as part of the BigScience project. Accessible via HuggingFace datasets API and web interface. Contributed to by 40+ researchers.
description: Largest Arabic NLP datasets catalogue with 600+ datasets and 25+ metadata attributes.
description_ar: أكبر فهرس عام لمجموعات بيانات معالجة اللغة الطبيعية العربية.
keywords: natural language processing, arabic nlp, datasets, arabic-nlp, datasets, catalogue, arabic

title_en: SOQAL - Neural Arabic Open Domain Question Answering
title: SOQAL
description_en: Open domain Arabic question answering system using Wikipedia as knowledge source. Includes the Arabic Reading Comprehension Dataset (ARCD) with 1,395 crowdworker questions, and Arabic-SQuAD with 48,344 machine-translated questions. System components: hierarchical TF-IDF document retriever, BERT-based neural reader achieving 61.3 F1 on ARCD, and linear answer ranking. Published at WANLP 2019.
description: Arabic open-domain QA system with ARCD dataset (1,395 questions) and BERT reader (61.3 F1).
keywords: natural language processing, arabic nlp, question answering, arabic-nlp, question-answering, deep-learning, arabic-language

title_en: Farasapy - Python Wrapper for Farasa Arabic NLP Toolkit
title: farasapy
description_en: Python API wrapper for the Farasa Arabic NLP toolkit (originally in Java). Supports segmentation, stemming, named entity recognition (NER), part-of-speech tagging (POS), diacritization, and lemmatization. Supports standalone and interactive modes, and includes a caching mechanism for repeated operations. Requires Java 1.7+. Install via pip.
description: Python wrapper for Farasa: Arabic segmentation, stemming, NER, POS tagging, diacritization.
keywords: natural language processing, arabic nlp, morphological analysis, arabic-nlp, farasa, python3, named-entity-recognition, postagging
